text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: I shall take my rest now.
choice_data_list: Yeah, go get plenty of rest.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ? Where is this...? I was certain I went to sleep.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Welcome! You're now in my magical space!
Unless you grant my wish, you won't be getting out!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...No, I get it now. This is a dream.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Jeez! This is what your stubborn cheeks get, take that!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Ugh............ My cheek hurts.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: I told you it's a magical space, didn't I?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
...Not being able to leave is a problem.
What is it that you wish for?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
—Hup! Look at this ocean.
Somewhere out there, a white flower is floating.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...So I just need to go get that, right?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Look at you, you get it♪
Then, with magic, let's change into a swimsuit—

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Not needed.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: —Haaaaahh!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: H-Huuuh!? Running across the sea...!?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...Found it. This is the one.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Right... But...

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ? Why the surprise?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Anyone would be surprised!
Doing something that makes zero sense like that!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
However...
this is a "magical space," is it not?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Even things that seem unrealistic should be possible to achieve.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
...Hey, do you
know what they call someone like that?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: It's called being honest to a fault! ...Fufufuâª

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: It was a dream, then.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...Dream or not, that was a good run...
